ModMetaData.name: Dyze's Pathogenics
ModMetaData.author: Dyze
ModMetaData.description:
Dyze's Pathogenics replaces random illness events with a realistic disease simulation.
Disease enters your colony through visitors, traders, raiders, and refugees — then spreads through proximity exposure. The catch: symptoms don't appear immediately. Infected colonists can spread illness before you even know they're sick.
Features: - Proximity-based respiratory transmission - Hidden incubation period before symptoms appear - Outsider importation (visitors, traders, raiders, refugees, prisoners, quest pawns) - Mask protection from face-covering apparel - Symptom notifications and debug overlay - Configurable balancing settings - Cross-map registry and release-hardening improvements
If this version ever gets into a broken prototype-like state, use the debug action "Reset all Pathogenics state worldwide".
That's mostly vibe coded.
v1.0-rc — Release candidate. Requires RimWorld 1.6 and Harmony.
